title: authentication_sign_up_with_email_and_password
description: Test user registration via POST /api/auth/sign-up/email with valid email and password, expect 201 Created and user record created.

title: authentication_sign_in_with_email_and_password
description: Test user login via POST /api/auth/sign-in/email with correct credentials, expect 200 OK and session cookie.

title: authentication_sign_in_with_google_oauth
description: Test social login via POST /api/auth/sign-in/social with valid Google OAuth token, expect 200 OK and session cookie.

title: authentication_sign_out_and_session_invalidation
description: Test sign out via POST /api/auth/sign-out, expect 204 No Content and subsequent GET /api/auth/get-session returns 401 Unauthorized.

title: incoming_mail_create_with_attachments
description: Test creating new incoming mail via POST /api/surat-masuk with required fields and attachments, expect 201 Created and mail ID returned.

title: outgoing_mail_list_pagination
description: Test listing outgoing mails via GET /api/surat-keluar with pagination parameters, expect paginated list of mails.

title: archive_management_create_and_view
description: Test creating new archive record via POST /api/arsip and viewing it via GET /api/arsip/:id, expect 201 Created and correct archive metadata.

title: dashboard_view_statistics
description: Test retrieving dashboard statistics via GET /api/dashboard, expect mail and archive KPIs and summary data.

title: user_management_create_and_role_update
description: Test creating a new user via POST /api/users and updating user role via PUT /api/users/:id, expect 201 Created and 200 OK respectively.

title: classification_management_delete_in_use_code
description: Test deleting a classification code that is currently in use via DELETE /api/klasifikasi/:id, expect 409 Conflict and error message 'classification in use'.
